market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $82,000 October 5-11?
market.rules:
This market will immediately resolve to "Yes" if any Binance 1 minute candle for Bitcoin (BTC/USDT) during the date range specified in the title (from 12:00 AM ET on the first date to 11:59 PM ET on the last) has a final "Low" price equal to or lower than the price specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the BTC/USDT "Low" prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/BTC_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance BTC/USDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.

The page labels the series 'Dodgers lead 2-1', which appears to treat the in-progress game as a win. The game was NOT final when checked.

recent_facts.source: Web search summary (CBS Sports gametracker / Yahoo live blog snippets)
recent_facts.fact: A search summary said the Dodgers won Game 3 3-0, but it contradicted itself on details (it also said Freeman homered leading off the 6th and that Atlanta scored a run). Treat a Game 3 final as unconfirmed.
NLDS Game 1 at Dodger Stadium: Dodgers 5, Braves 3.
NLDS Game 2 at Dodger Stadium: Braves 3, Dodgers 2. Atlanta knocked Blake Snell out early and won with a bullpen game, tying the best-of-five series 1-1.

Game 3 was Tuesday, Oct 6, 6:00 PM ET at Truist Park (Atlanta). Game 4, if needed, is Wednesday, Oct 7, 6:00 PM ET at Truist Park with starters TBD. A Game 5, if needed, would be at Dodger Stadium. The series is best-of-five: first to 3 wins advances.
The Dodgers won 100 regular-season games and got a first-round bye. The Braves went 94-68 (third-best record in the NL) and beat the Phillies in the best-of-three Wild Card Series.

Regular-season head-to-head: Braves won 5 of 6 games against the Dodgers and outscored them 26-15 (small sample). That included a 1-0 Sale complete-game shutout over Yamamoto on Aug 27 (9 IP, 5 H, 11 K).

Coming into Game 3, Sale had pitched 7.2 postseason innings in 2026 with 12 K and a 3.52 ERA. He had previously started on short rest in the Wild Card round. Yamamoto, the reigning World Series MVP, allowed 6 ER in 37.1 IP in the 2025 postseason, and Braves batters were hitting .196 in 51 AB against him.
Historical base rate (unverified, no case count given): when a best-of-five series is tied 1-1, the Game 3 winner has gone on to win about 72% of the time.

This is the sixth Dodgers-Braves postseason meeting and the first since the 2021 NLCS, which Atlanta won on its way to the World Series title (small-sample background). The Dodgers are the two-time defending World Series champions.

market.question: The Social Reckoning Rotten Tomatoes score? (Above 65)
market.rules:
If The Social Reckoning has a Tomatometer score of above 65 on Oct 12, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

recent_facts.fact: When fetched on 2026-10-07, the film's Rotten Tomatoes page (/m/the_social_reckoning) listed 0 Tomatometer reviews and 0 Popcornmeter ratings and was marked 'Coming Soon'. It gives the release date as October 9, 2026, a rating of R and a runtime of 1h 52m.

recent_facts.source: Web search summary (no outlet named; unverified)
recent_facts.fact: UNVERIFIED: A search-result summary said the film 'sits at 85% on Rotten Tomatoes off 20 reviews as of October 6.' No outlet was named, and this conflicts with the Rotten Tomatoes page showing 0 reviews, so treat it as unconfirmed.

The full-review embargo was reported to lift Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at 9 AM ET, two days before the Friday, October 9 US release. Resolution is checked Monday, October 12 at 10:00 AM ET, so about 5 days of reviews will build up.
Early full-review grades reported in search results: The Guardian gave it 2 out of 5 stars (would count as Rotten) and IndieWire gave it a B+ (would count as Fresh).

World of Reel called reactions 'rather mid' and listed critics' complaints about 'flat, TV-like visuals, an overbearing Desplat score' and a poorly executed January 6th riot sequence. It praised Mikey Madison and Jeremy Allen White. It reported opening-weekend tracking of $4–6M on a $50M budget.

Variety's roundup of first social-media reactions after Monday press screenings used phrases like 'solid sequel', 'good, just not great film' and 'harsh assessment of Zuckerberg'. One reaction said 'a slow and steady build leads to a climax that suitably got my blood boiling.'

THR's first-reactions roundup was mixed. One critic called it 'a decent journalism drama that lives in the shadow of its much superior predecessor' with 'an okay script with okay direction'. Another called it 'a true return to form for Aaron Sorkin and easily his best film since Molly's Game.'
A published review headlined 'Sorkin's Sequel Lacks Fincher' described the film as 'a sharp op-ed missing its Fincher', a mixed take.

Some first reactions called the film 'essential viewing'. Commentator Patrick Tomasso praised the investigative-journalism story but criticized Sorkin's direction. Several reactions said the material 'feels like it's arriving five years too late.'
Aaron Sorkin publicly said the film's reshoots had nothing to do with backlash to the trailer, which confirms the film had reshoots before release.

Online commentary pointed out that a Wednesday review embargo for a Friday release is often read as a sign the studio lacks confidence. Other commentary said a Wednesday embargo means the studio is 'in no hurry to start the conversation.'
